g.text: Figure 20-4 — One rewrite fires as a metered COMM cascade
visible fire = ONE COMM; congruence cascade =
accept COMM — the ONE visible fire
cascade — congruence (only if the RHS needs substitution)
Metered by construction: every COMM passes through the interpreter's
cost accounting — no manual hook, no unmetered host pre-computation.
